latency_inputs.text: 不要查北京天气，我们聊小猫。
请你简单说说小猫为什么喜欢晒太阳。
给我讲一个很短的笑话。

comparison: R13 Worker vs final R15 Worker with the same final Brain and fresh per-pair context; separate final-R15 search off/on contrasts required for search-overhead claims
protocol: One room at a time; at least 30s between rooms; fresh sessions with matching account/context snapshot and immutable WAV hash
Source/dtx/frame/queue parameters identical in paired arms; record every readiness/ASR/missing-body failure
Count paired latency only when actual chat commit and body PCM both match the declared input; keep all attempts and >3s slow rounds
Record whether search/resume actually overlapped the chat; absent overlap is uncovered, not mixed-load pass
Never replace failure speech with answer success; reviewed content and references required
